0.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_1
0.description: Aside from the aetheryte, there is precious little else of interest in Swiftperch. You are, however, welcome to stay as long as you like.
0.translation_description: A parte l'eterite, Swiftperch non offre molto altro da vedere. Ma puoi fermarti quanto vuoi.

1.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_2
1.description: Up until the Calamity reduced this place to a smoking ruin, I aided my father in raising crops of wheat.
1.translation_description: Fino a quando la Calamità non ha ridotto questo posto a un cumulo di macerie fumanti, aiutavo mio padre a coltivare il grano.

2.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_3
2.description: Now my dear old dad is gone, our once-beautiful fields are untilled and overgrown, and our dodo livestock has learned a taste for unfettered freedom.
2.translation_description: Ora il mio caro vecchio papà non c'è più, i campi un tempo splendidi sono incolti e invasi dalle erbacce, e i dodo che allevavamo hanno imparato ad amare la libertà.

3.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_4
3.description: But I will not let this tragedy defeat me! I have sworn to restore my father's beloved settlement to the way it was when he yet lived─single-handedly, if I must.
3.translation_description: Ma non permetterò che questa tragedia mi sconfigga! Ho giurato di riportare l'insediamento che mio padre amava tanto a com'era quando era in vita─anche se dovessi fare tutto con le mie sole forze.

4.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_5
4.description: This settlement was constructed here as part of the efforts to rebuild the destroyed aetheryte camps after...well, after that horrible incident.
4.translation_description: L'insediamento fu costruito qui nell'ambito degli sforzi per ricostruire gli accampamenti eterici distrutti dopo... be', dopo quel terribile incidente.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_6
5.description: It was originally found further to the northwest, but when we returned from Limsa Lominsa─we were taking shelter from the fiery destruction and such, you see─there was not much left of our homes or fields.
5.translation_description: In origine si trovava più a nord-ovest, ma al ritorno da Limsa Lominsa─ci eravamo rifugiati per sfuggire alla distruzione causata dalle fiamme, capisci─delle nostre case e dei campi era rimasto ben poco.

6.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_LYULF_000_7
6.description: The scene that greeted us was enough to wilt our very spirits. Folk were left with barely enough enthusiasm to shuffle about in a fugue-like depression, let alone lift a hoe or mend a fence. But I have plans to expel this air of defeat with a fresh breath of hope!
6.translation_description: La scena che ci accolse bastò a spegnere ogni entusiasmo. La gente si trascinava in giro, abbattuta e incapace persino di impugnare una zappa o riparare una staccionata. Ma ho un piano: scacciare quest'aria di sconfitta e far soffiare una brezza di speranza!

9.name: TEXT_REGSEASWIFTPERCH_00072_A1_000_2
9.description: What manner of place is Swiftperch?
